notes: The room is the owner's 7 by 4 paces (5.25 by 3.0 m) from eliab_house, unchanged, and the gate lamp shows through the east doorway from the table and the west stools, 34 m away in the north gatepost.

Eliab sits at the head on the north stool with his back to the hearth, Micah at his right hand, Asher beside Micah facing the door and the gate lamp, and Amos at the foot among the hired men, so father and elder son face each other down the table.

The far end is crowded with five hired men on the sleeping bench, the floor and Asher's mat, and Dan (12) on the mill's reed mat, because the screenplay seats the whole household; everyone keeps their place through the meal, so the plan draws camera paths only.
The light is one clay lamp on the table and the last grey light from the open door; the hearth is banked under Miriam's pot and gives warmth and breath, and the lamp gives the light.

Signature move, W07 to W12, the camera passes along the open side of the table from Eliab's laugh to Asher's grin to Amos eating in silence, and settles on Amos's jaw at the demand with Asher and Eliab beyond him.
The camera works the open east side between the table and the door, and reaches the west side by walking round the foot of the table among the hired men (W01, W03, W10).
The scene is two long takes, W01 to W11 (94 s) and W12 to W20 (74 s), joined by one bread stitch, Asher's round under his flat hand to Amos's round in his hands, 0.7 m apart.
The Scene 12 flash of the dog trotting off with a round of bread cuts in at that bread stitch, at the end of W11.
After the demand Amos's eyes go up the table to his father, and he drops them to the table when Eliab looks at him first, as the screenplay has it.

W13 and W14 stay at Amos's jaw by choice while the room goes still; insets A and B hold the windows at the foot and the head of the table, and the main map keeps the walks and the signature pass (W07).
